content.text: Ligar para SAC americano é a situação que mais trava brasileiros na gringa: sistema automático rápido, sotaque difícil, siglas desconhecidas, e script de retenção agressivo. Este módulo cobre 100 trocas reais para você sair com o que precisa de qualquer ligação.

data.content: Atalho universal: dizer "operator", "representative" ou "agent", ou apertar "0" repetidamente — a maioria dos sistemas americanos transfere para humano. Se não funcionar: "I need to speak with a customer service representative, please."

rows: "I did not get that. Can you repeat the options?"
Apertar "0" geralmente funciona quando o reconhecimento falha
"Your call is important to us" — significa: vai demorar. Tenha paciência
"Yes, I would like a callback." — aceite quando oferecido, economiza tempo
"My account number is... / My last 4 digits are... / My zip code is..."
"I am calling about [assunto]." — diga imediatamente ao conectar com humano
"Can I get a confirmation number or case number?"
"Hi, I'm calling about [assunto]. My name is [nome] and my account number is [número]."
Pedir ao atendente para se identificar
"Could I get your name and employee ID for my records?"
"English is not my first language — could you please speak slowly?"
"I'm sorry, could you repeat that?" / "Could you say that again, please?"
"So you are saying that... Is that correct?" — sempre confirme o que você entendeu
"Could you send me a confirmation email?"
"I'm having trouble hearing you. Could you speak up a bit?"
"We got disconnected. I was speaking with [nome] about [assunto]."
"Before you transfer me, can you give me your direct extension?"

data.content: Script de retenção: empresas americanas treinam atendentes para argumentar contra cancelamentos com ofertas, descontos e perguntas. Seja firme: "I appreciate the offer, but I have made my decision. Please proceed with the cancellation."

rows: "I am calling to cancel my [serviço] account. Account number [número]."
"I appreciate the offer, but my decision is final."
"I do not want to pause — I want to cancel completely."
"I will not be charged after [data], correct?"
"Can I get a cancellation confirmation number?"
"Can you send the cancellation confirmation to my email?"
"My contract says I need to give 30 days notice. Is that correct?"
"When and where do I return the equipment?"
"I am calling to dispute a charge on my account."
"On [data], I was charged [valor] for [item] which I did not authorize."
"I was charged for a service I did not receive."
"I see a duplicate charge — I was billed twice for the same item."
"I returned this item on [data] and have not received the refund yet."
"How long will the refund take to process?"
"I see a pending charge. Will that be released?"
"I would like to speak with a supervisor, please."
"So the charge of [valor] will be reversed within [prazo]. Is that correct?"
"I would like to schedule an appointment for [tipo de serviço]."
"What is the service window? Will someone call before arriving?"
"The address is [endereço]. Do you have that on file?"
"What number will the technician call from?"
"I need to reschedule my appointment. What are the available slots?"
"I need to cancel my appointment for [data / hora]."
"Can you send a confirmation to my email?"
"The technician did not show up for my appointment. I need to reschedule and I would like a credit."
"I would like to speak with your supervisor, please."
"I understand you cannot resolve this — could you escalate it to someone who can?"
"I have been a customer for [tempo] and this experience has been unacceptable."
"If this is not resolved, I will have to cancel my account."
"I would like to file a formal complaint. Who do I contact?"
"Can I have a manager call me back? When can I expect that call?"
"I am frustrated with this situation, but I know it is not your personal fault. I need this resolved."
"I will call back when I can speak with someone who is authorized to help me."
"I will file a complaint with the Better Business Bureau if this is not resolved."
"If you cannot resolve this, I will dispute the charge with my credit card company."

data.content: Tom assertivo vs agressivo: "I am not satisfied and I need this resolved" (assertivo) funciona melhor do que "This is ridiculous!" (agressivo). Atendentes têm mais poder para ajudar quem é respeitoso. Mencionar cancelamento ou BBB são ferramentas legítimas para situações que realmente não foram resolvidas — use com moderação.

Take-aways. Para falar com humano: diga "representative" ou aperte "0". Cancele com decisão: "I have made my decision — please proceed." Disputas: data + valor + motivo específico. Peça SEMPRE o número de confirmação ao final de qualquer resolução. Tom assertivo mas respeitoso resolve mais do que raiva. Confirmação por email é seu comprovante — sempre peça.
